rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for eating food, and it also works with resources, tape, or money when context makes the metaphor clear.

example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 zo2 go3 ping4 gwo2 sin1

rows.note: Use this specifically when “eat” means have a meal, especially in expressions such as asking what time to eat.

example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 gei2 dim2 sik6 faan6 aa3

rows.note: Use this when a machine or device takes inserted money without delivering the service or returning the payment.

example.english: That machine can eat your money but won't give you a drink.
example.traditional: 嗰部機食錢，但係唔出飲品。
example.jyutping: go2 bou6 gei1 sik6 cin4 daan6 hai6 m4 ceot1 jam2 ban2

rows.note: Use this phrase when describing having a healthy diet rather than merely eating food.

example.english: We want to eat healthy, so we eat less fried food.
example.traditional: 我哋想食得健康，少食啲炸嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 sik6 dak1 gin6 hong1 siu2 sik6 di1 zaa3 je5
